```{r}
# Bayesian logistic regression pipeline for tsunami prediction
# File: bayes_tsunami_analysis.R
# Prasyarat: install.packages(c("tidyverse","brms","bayesplot","loo","rjags","coda","gridExtra"))
# NOTE: if using cmdstanr, follow its installation instructions for brms backend.

library(tidyverse)
library(brms)       # interface to Stan
library(bayesplot)  # plotting MCMC
library(loo)        # WAIC, LOO
library(coda)
library(gridExtra)
```
```{r}
library(readr)
df <- read_csv("earthquake_data_tsunami.csv")
view(df)
```
```{r}
# Quick look
glimpse(df)
# Ensure tsunami is 0/1 numeric
df <- df %>%
  mutate(tsunami = as.integer(tsunami),
         Year = as.integer(Year),
         Month = as.integer(Month))
```
```{r}
# 2. Choose predictors
# Based on available columns: magnitude, depth, dmin, gap, mmi, cdi, sig, nst, etc.
# I'll build a reasonably simple yet meaningful model; you can vary predictors.
formula_brms <- bf(tsunami ~ magnitude + depth + dmin + gap + mmi + cdi + sig)
```

```{r}
# 3. Priors (explainable, weakly-informative)
priors <- c(
  set_prior("normal(0, 2.5)", class = "b"),        # coefficients
  set_prior("normal(0, 5)", class = "Intercept")  # intercept
)
```

```{r}
# 4. Fit Bayesian logistic regression with brms (Stan)
# Increase iter/warmup if needed; set adapt_delta to avoid divergences
fit_brms <- brm(
  formula = formula_brms,
  data = df,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior = priors,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,      # 4000 iterations per chain (1000 warmup default if warmup not set)
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 1234,
  refresh = 100
)

# Save model
saveRDS(fit_brms, file = "fit_brms_tsunami.rds")
```



```{r}
# 5. Convergence diagnostics
print(fit_brms)          # Rhat, bulk/tail ess
summary(fit_brms)

# Traceplots (use posterior draws)
mcmc_trace(as.array(fit_brms), pars = c("b_Intercept", "b_magnitude", "b_depth", "b_dmin", "b_gap", "b_mmi", "b_cdi", "b_sig"))
# Also rank plots
mcmc_rank_overlay(as.array(fit_brms), pars = c("b_magnitude","b_depth","b_dmin"))
```

```{r}
# 6. Posterior summary & credible intervals
posterior_summary <- posterior_summary(fit_brms)   # mean, sd, quantiles, Rhat
posterior_summary

# plot intervals
mcmc_intervals(as.array(fit_brms), pars = c("b_magnitude", "b_depth", "b_dmin", "b_gap", "b_mmi", "b_cdi", "b_sig"))

```

```{r}
# 7. Posterior predictive checks (PPC)
pp_check(fit_brms, nsamples = 100)          # default: overlay predictive distribution on observed
pp_check(fit_brms, type = "bars")           # for binary outcomes: bar-plot check of proportion 1s
pp_check(fit_brms, type = "hist", nsamples = 50)
```

```{r}
# 8. Model fit statistics: WAIC and LOO
# brms offers loo() and waic() wrappers; these use pointwise log-likelihood
waic_fit <- waic(fit_brms)
loo_fit  <- loo(fit_brms)

waic_fit
loo_fit

# Note: for loo, check pareto_k diagnostics
print(loo_fit$diagnostics)   # to check problem observations (Pareto k)

```

```{r}
# 9. ROC/AUC and accuracy (posterior predictive approach)
# Get posterior predicted probabilities for each observation (posterior predictive mean)
pp <- posterior_epred(fit_brms, re_formula = NA) # matrix draws x N
pp_mean <- apply(pp, 2, mean)                     # mean predicted prob per obs
pred_class <- ifelse(pp_mean > 0.5, 1, 0)
conf_mat <- table(Predicted = pred_class, Actual = df$tsunami)
conf_mat

# AUC: use pROC if available
if (requireNamespace("pROC", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(pROC)
  roc_obj <- roc(df$tsunami, pp_mean)
  print(auc(roc_obj))
  plot(roc_obj, main = "ROC curve (posterior mean predictions)")
}
```

```{r}
# 10. OPTIONAL: compute DIC via JAGS (because brms/stan do not directly give DIC)
# If you want DIC, run an equivalent JAGS model (MCMC) and compute DIC:
run_DIC_via_JAGS <- FALSE
if (run_DIC_via_JAGS) {
  # build model string
  jags_model_string <- "
  model {
    for (i in 1:N) {
      y[i] ~ dbern(p[i])
      logit(p[i]) <- beta0 + inprod(beta[], X[i,])
    }
    beta0 ~ dnorm(0, 1.0/25)      # normal(0,5^2) precision = 1/25
    for (j in 1:K) {
      beta[j] ~ dnorm(0, 1.0/6.25)  # normal(0,2.5^2)
    }
  }"
  # Prepare data for JAGS
  # pick same covariates order as formula
  Xmat <- as.matrix(df %>% select(magnitude, depth, dmin, gap, mmi, cdi, sig))
  jags_data <- list(N = nrow(df), K = ncol(Xmat), y = df$tsunami, X = Xmat)
  jags_mod <- jags.model(textConnection(jags_model_string), data = jags_data, n.chains = 3, quiet = FALSE)
  update(jags_mod, n.iter = 2000)   # burn-in
  dic_out <- dic.samples(jags_mod, n.iter = 5000, type = "pD")
  print(dic_out)
}
```

```{r}
# 11. Save important outputs
saveRDS(list(posterior_summary = posterior_summary, waic = waic_fit, loo = loo_fit, pp_mean = pp_mean, conf_mat = conf_mat),
        file = "bayes_tsunami_results.rds")
```

```{r}
# 12. Quick textual report pieces (to copy into the paper)
cat("\n=== Quick model summary ===\n")
print(posterior_summary)
cat("\nWAIC:\n"); print(waic_fit)
cat("\nLOO:\n"); print(loo_fit)
cat("\nConfusion matrix (posterior mean cutoff 0.5):\n")
print(conf_mat)
```

summary(fit_brms)

```{r}
#  LOAD BAYESIAN TSUNAMI MODEL & RESULTS (RDS FILES) (not important)
# ============================================================

# 2. Read the brms model
fit_brms <- readRDS("fit_brms_tsunami.rds")

# 3. Read the results list (posterior summary, WAIC, LOO, pp_mean, conf_mat)
bayes_results <- readRDS("bayes_tsunami_results.rds")

# ============================================================
# 4. Check contents
# ============================================================
print(names(bayes_results))
# Expected:
# "posterior_summary" "waic" "loo" "pp_mean" "conf_mat"

# ============================================================
# 5. Extract objects
# ============================================================

posterior_summary <- bayes_results$posterior_summary
waic_fit          <- bayes_results$waic
loo_fit           <- bayes_results$loo
pp_mean           <- bayes_results$pp_mean
conf_mat          <- bayes_results$conf_mat

# ============================================================
# 6. Display results
# ============================================================

cat("\n===== POSTERIOR SUMMARY =====\n")
print(posterior_summary)

cat("\n===== WAIC =====\n")
print(waic_fit)

cat("\n===== LOO =====\n")
print(loo_fit)

cat("\n===== Confusion Matrix (Posterior Predictions) =====\n")
print(conf_mat)
```
